note: Legal's lines for screens, ads desk (handoffs/turnkey.md part 5), word for word. Use these words, or ask Legal before changing their meaning.
question: Is this ad about housing, jobs, credit or another financial product, or about politics, an election or a social issue?
politics: HQ doesn't make political or social issue ads. They need the platform's own checks, so make them there.
tiktokSpecial: Turn on TikTok's Special Ad Category toggle
tiktokAi: Turn on 'This ad contains AI-generated content'
blocked: Ads made with 127 can't promise income, earnings or guaranteed results, or show before-and-after results. Say what you do and who it's for instead.
backup: Can you back this up? Ads need proof for claims like this. Add the source to your Brain, or take it out.
restricted: {Network} limits ads for {category}. Check its rules before you turn this on.
optimizer: {Change} · {campaign} · {spend effect}. Why: {the numbers}. Nothing changes until you tap OK.
optimizerFiles: In this version HQ doesn't connect to your ad accounts, so the OK is yours to give in the network itself: nothing changes until you make the change there.
studioAi: AI-made person. Label it "AI-generated" where people could take it for real, and turn on the platform's AI label when you post.
what: Drafts your ads, checks the claims, and suggests changes for your OK.
